title: OtterBox iPhone 16 Plus Statement Series Cactus Leather Case

comparisons.notes: Exact Statement Series Cactus Leather for MagSafe iPhone 16 Plus; Azure Oasis Blue MPN 77-96969 and Mojave Moss Green 77-96971 both in stock (Shopify available=true) at $48.99. Woot image matches Azure Oasis two-tone blue.

writeup: Woot has a new OtterBox Statement Series cactus-leather MagSafe case for the iPhone 16 Plus in Azure Oasis (MPN 77-96969) for $3.99. OtterBox currently has that exact Azure Oasis Blue color, plus Mojave Moss Green (77-96971), in stock at $48.99. That is 91 percent and about $45 below OtterBox's current price. The case includes a Camera Control cutout and metal buttons. Quantity is 4+ left, with a limit of 4 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0FH5W5LVK as an exact match for the OtterBox iPhone 16 Plus Statement Series cactus-leather case (Azure Oasis / 77-96969).
